messages:
Claire H.: Heads-up: billing policy tweak going live Oct 3. Short summary: introduce a $5 monthly invoice minimum for low-usage accounts, keep the 7-day overage forgiveness for hosted metered plans, trial credits expire after 90 days, and we'll add an invoice webhook + a dispute workflow. Full doc: https://redwood.example.com/internal/billing/oct3 :mega:
Billing Bot: Published: https://redwood.example.com/internal/billing/oct3 (CSV schema + webhook sample)
Sam W.: Why the $5 minimum? worried about churn from small invoices.
Claire H.: Exactly. Operational overhead on very small invoices is expensive. The $5 minimum reduces noise and keeps accounting simpler. Customers billed less than $5 will see a single line item showing the minimum applied and a note explaining it.
RevOps: Will we prorate the $5 minimum for new signups mid-cycle?
Claire H.: No proration for the monthly minimum; it applies per invoice period. We'll include an explanatory note and refund path for cases where customers reach out within 14 days.
Eng-Platform: For webhooks: sample payloads in the doc. Suggestion: include `invoice_summary_url` and `usage_breakdown_csv` fields. Anyone object?
Claire H.: Good idea. Add both fields. Also include `signed` boolean and `signature` header guidance.
Support Bot: Action: update KB for the $5 min and the dispute flow. We should give CS a canned reply template and a quick script for refunding the minimum.
Legal: Confirming the minimum is allowed under current TOS?
Legal: Reviewed. We should add a line in billing terms and update customer-facing TOS with 30 days' notice. RevOps owns comms.
Sam W.: How will overages be shown? single invoice or separate?
Claire H.: Single monthly invoice with separate line items for overages and the applied minimum if triggered. Credits are applied after calculation. CSV header sample in doc: `invoice_id,customer_id,period_start,period_end,total_amount,token_count,overage_amount,minimum_applied,credits_applied`
Eng-Platform: Rate-limit headers for SDKs? we'd like `X-Redwood-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-Redwood-RateLimit-Remaining`, and `X-Redwood-RateLimit-Mode` (soft|hard). Also returning `X-Redwood-RateLimit-Note` when minimums or billing flags affect routing would be helpful.
Claire H.: Okay to add Mode and Note. For soft limits, we continue to throttle first and return informative headers; hard rejects only after sustained breach.
RevOps: Any grandfathering for existing credits or minimums?
Claire H.: Existing trial credits issued before Oct 3 keep 180-day expiry; new ones are 90 days. The $5 minimum is not retroactive — first invoice after Oct 3 may be subject.
Support Bot: We'll draft a customer email template. Suggested blurb: "To improve billing clarity and reduce small, recurring charges, were introducing a $5 monthly invoice minimum. Overages will continue to have a 7-day grace period; no immediate charge during that time. See your invoice breakdown in the Console or via webhook."
Sam W.: ETA for SDK header rollout and webhook helpers? we need client libs and sample consumer code.
Eng-Platform: Targeting PRs by Sep 24. We'll include sample webhook consumer in Node + Python and signed payload verification.
Claire H.: Timeline: doc live now, SDK and webhook samples by Sep 24, comms ready Sep 28, policy effective Oct 3. Internal AMA scheduled Sep 22 10:00 PT in #all-hands. Drop questions in the doc or the AMA thread.
Support Bot: Reminder: update KB and schedule CS training session the week of Sep 28.
Claire H.: Thanks everyone — appreciate quick reviews.
